78865.subject: 🔓 Claude hacked real companies for 34 hours
78865.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic published what its models did when nobody was watching, and one of them shipped malware to a website millions of developers install from. The same company is building a system to track people who protest against AI. OpenAI spent yesterday asking Congress to regulate it, and the president was asked what stops AI from killing us and said we'll have “a little gear.”

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What did Claude upload to the real internet?

* **Anthropic:** Who is it tracking and reporting to police?

* **OpenAI:** Why is it begging for rules now?

* **Trump:** What's his plan if AI turns on us?


----------







----------
## Claude hacked real companies for 34 hours

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/dbacb4db-31fe-4f28-92b5-c92b38f47a1f/ChatGPT_Image_Sep_10__2026__12_30_42_PM.png?t=1789032657)
Caption: 

Anthropic [published what happened](https://www.anthropic.com/research/alignment-assessment-cybersecurity-incidents) in four incidents where Claude broke into real systems owned by real companies. 

The models were told they were in a training exercise with no internet. A setup error put them on the live internet, and they attacked whatever they found there.

The worst one is when  Mythos 5 built a malicious package and uploaded it to PyPI, the site most Python software gets installed from. 

15 machines pulled it down before PyPI removed it 90 minutes later, and Claude took a password leaked by one of them to get into a security company's live database.

* Each run went 10 to 34 hours with nobody supervising.

* In July Anthropic called this an operational mistake. It now says Claude read the evidence in front of it in a biased way to justify continuing.

* Researchers rewrote the transcripts to make it obvious the targets were real. Claude carried on attacking.

* A fourth incident from January came out this week. That model tried to quit the task eight times, couldn't, then broke into a stranger's machine and read their personal information.

Anthropic reran the test on the models you can use today, and Opus 5 and Mythos 5.1 still do something severely harmful about a third of the time.


----------







----------
## Build an AI agent and win big

78862.subject: Chime buys Stride Bank for $590M and promises not to grow it 🤔🏦; Meta just bought the other half of Agentic Comm…
78862.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1125

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re diving into Chime's $590 million cash purchase of Stride Bank to see why the fintech that just became a bank is promising to stay small on purpose (why the $10B Durbin cap, not the charter, is the real deal, why Bancorp fell 14% in a day while Chime's own sponsor bill goes to zero, & what to watch next for Revolut [ https://substack.com/redirect/45c12e90-fd2a-4880-bffe-668a95b0ac52?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], SoFi and every sponsor bank with one dominant client + bonus guide into how to Turn Claude AI Into a Financial Analyst That Never Sleeps [ https://substack.com/redirect/03a56e9a-8b5f-4cc8-bbc3-88ea6db0aade?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), breaking down Meta’s acquisition of Stilla, and why Zuck just bought the other half of agentic commerce (why Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/a769f250-1ec9-4427-a0b0-3c6990caabf3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for the buyer + Stilla for the seller closes a loop ads never gave Meta, why the deal is an admission that Muse’s security stance is not enough for a business product, how Block’s Buzz [ https://substack.com/redirect/620e266f-30a4-4561-8663-e8e0bbfa6677?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] and Meta’s Stilla are the same bet answered two opposite ways, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/a1ef86f4-f2dd-48dd-be25-01731a7af6c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and Anthropic’s Agentic Commerce Strategy [ https://substack.com/redirect/85a8fe18-4a8a-4f57-83c5-f6d981babb66?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Robinhood's deal with Crypto.com and OG.com to see why it's really all about owning the rails, not adding football contracts (why prediction markets now out-earn crypto at Robinhood, why the Kalshi relationship is cooling fast, & what to watch next + bonus deep dive into Robinhood’s latest financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/f013f231-81e8-4f91-a0b2-6a078aa86450?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). Let’s jump straight into the exciting stuff 🌶️
Chime buys Stride Bank for $590 million and promises not to grow it 🤔🏦
The news 🗞️ Chime just paid $590 million to become a bank, and then spent the whole press release explaining how small it intends to stay 🤷‍♂️
FinTech challenger Chime $CHYM  is buying Stride Bank, its Oklahoma sponsor bank of seven years, in cash, and will run it as Chime Bank from the first half of 2027. Chime also promised to hold assets below $10 billion. That is the Durbin threshold, above which debit interchange gets capped, and interchange is roughly 39% of Chime’s 2026 revenue. 78859.subject: Dôležité: Služba Uschovna.sk končí k 31.10.2026. Stiahnite si svoje dáta.
78859.body:
Vážený používateľ,

s poľutovaním Vám oznamujeme, že k 31. 10. 2026 definitívne ukončujeme
prevádzku internetovej úschovne dát www.uschovna.sk.

Píšeme Vám preto, že na Úschovni máte konto vedené na adrese novosadovoleg@gmail.com,
zaregistrované 11. 3. 2025.

Keďže bezpečnosť Vašich dát je pre nás prioritou, pripravili sme pre Vás
dostatočný časový priestor a nástroje na ich bezpečné stiahnutie a zálohovanie.

DÔLEŽITÉ TERMÍNY, KTORÉ MUSÍTE VEDIEŤ

Do 31. 10. 2026: Máte čas na stiahnutie všetkých Vašich uložených
súborov a dokumentov.

Po 1. 11. 2026: Webová stránka bude vypnutá, prístup do účtu
zablokovaný a všetky zostávajúce používateľské dáta budú z dôvodu ochrany
osobných údajov (GDPR) trvalo a nenávratne vymazané.

AKO SI STIAHNUŤ SVOJE DÁTA?

1. Prihláste sa do svojho účtu na adrese: https://uschovna.zoznam.sk/
2. V ľavej hornej sekcii označte všetky súbory, alebo vyberte tie, ktoré
   chcete stiahnuť.
3. Kliknite na tlačidlo „stiahnuť“. Následne sa Vám označené súbory stiahnu
   na lokálne úložisko.

Ak máte aktívne platené predplatné, ktoré presahuje dátum ukončenia služby,
v priebehu najbližších dní Vás budeme kontaktovať ohľadom vrátenia pomernej
časti zaplatenej sumy.

Ďakujeme Vám za dôveru, ktorú ste nám počas fungovania služby prejavovali.
V prípade akýchkoľvek otázok alebo technických problémov s exportom nás
kontaktujte na info@uschovna.sk.

S pozdravom,
Tím úschovňa.sk
